name: crypto_price
description: Retrieves real-time price data for any cryptocurrency listed on CoinGecko. Accepts a coin name or ticker symbol and a target fiat currency. Returns the current price, 24-hour percentage change, market capitalisation, and 24-hour trading volume. Supports all major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, Cardano (ADA), Dogecoin (DOGE), Polygon (MATIC), Chainlink (LINK), Avalanche (AVAX), and 10,000+ additional coins. Use this tool when an agent needs the current price of any digital asset, needs to value a cryptocurrency holding in fiat, monitor portfolio performance, or report on crypto market conditions.

coin.description: Cryptocurrency name or ticker symbol. Accepts common symbols (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, LINK, AVAX) or full names (bitcoin, ethereum, solana). Case-insensitive.

currency.description: Target fiat currency code for the price. Defaults to USD. Examples: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad.

include_market_data.description: Whether to include market capitalisation and 24-hour trading volume alongside the price. Defaults to true.
